assignments.role: Backend Unified Authentication, Plutosw4 Studio Access & E2E Pipeline Quotas
assignments.scope: Investigate why POST /api/auth/login returns 401 Unauthorized for accounts created via admin portal and for master admin pluto. Ensure: 1) Master admin pluto (with password plutosw4) can log into both /api/auth/login (client studio) and /api/admin/login (admin portal). 2) All merchant accounts created via /api/admin/accounts can log into /api/auth/login with their configured password (PBKDF2 verification and password hashing consistency). 3) Support whitespace trimming and case-insensitive username lookup. 4) Ensure GET /api/auth/session and GET /api/auth/me recognize session tokens from both endpoints and return valid quotas. 5) Ensure pluto has unlimited quota (role='admin') and merchants have valid quotas. 6) Verify /api/jobs/create and /api/upload-and-process accept session tokens via Bearer header or cookie and successfully process video cuts without 401/403 errors. 7) Verify zero U+0669 characters. Update web/README.md; commit as MohammedBoure on branch backend/agy11-unified-auth-and-pipeline-fixes; notify coordinator.

assignments.role: Frontend Gated Login UX, Input Sanitation & Video Production Flow Auditing
assignments.scope: In web/static/app.js and web/static/index.html: 1) Audit the client login form (#loginView): trim input values, support Enter key submission, provide distinct user-friendly Arabic error messages if credentials fail (401) or account is suspended/expired (403). 2) Ensure credentials pluto / plutosw4 as well as any merchant account work seamlessly. 3) Store session token consistently in localStorage and cookie so /api/auth/session and subsequent API calls succeed. 4) Ensure the video production request (#btnProduceVideo) attaches the session token in Authorization header and handles both /api/jobs/create and /api/upload-and-process gracefully with clear progress indicators. 5) Audit visual/DOM state transitions between loginView, studioView, and settingsModal. 6) Verify zero U+0669 characters. Update web/static/README.md; commit as MohammedBoure on branch frontend/agy51-login-ux-and-studio-pipeline; notify coordinator.

assignments.role: Visual, Experiential & E2E Automated Integration Gatekeeper
assignments.scope: Author comprehensive end-to-end integration and visual/experiential tests in tests/test_e2e_auth_and_video_pipeline.py: 1) Admin pluto login -> create new merchant account via /api/admin/accounts. 2) Login to /api/auth/login as pluto AND as newly created merchant. 3) Verify /api/auth/session and quota allowance. 4) Produce video through /api/jobs/create and /api/upload-and-process end-to-end. 5) Test visual/DOM state transitions and error messages. 6) Verify zero U+0669 characters across repository. Merge backend and frontend into develop; commit as MohammedBoure; notify coordinator.
